name: Control of Networked & Complex Systems
description: Introduction to Networked and Complex Systems, and their representation using Graphs; Graphs, Digraphs and related matrices: Adjacency, Incidence and Laplacian matrices;Graph theoretic results, Gersgorin disc theorem, and matrix properties; Stochastic matrix, Perron-Frobenius results, Primitive matrix; Average consensus, Convergence analysis and agreement subspace; Formation specification, Formation invariants: scale, translation and rotation; Formation control, Rendezvous; Graph rigidity theory and formation; Consensus control for LTI agents; Leader-follower synchronization control; Complex system representation; Decentralized control.
